batch.title: Operational logistics delivery
batch.goal: Complete logistics, travel, lodging, catering, transport, equipment, advancing, and live operations with recipient acknowledgement.
exitCriteria: All operational records reference canonical event, stop, leg, organization, and recipient identities.
Producer, recipient acknowledgement, isolation, DST, partial failure, retry, and reversal journeys pass.

specTasks.title: Add/backfill non-null organization keys
acceptanceCriteria: Every travel/lodging/transport parent and child is scoped; unresolved rows are quarantined; counts and referential consistency are verified.

specTasks.title: Replace permissive RLS
acceptanceCriteria: Direct clients cannot list or mutate another organization through parent or child IDs; legitimate tour/logistics roles pass.

specTasks.title: Replace arbitrary CRUD payloads
acceptanceCriteria: Per-command schemas allow explicit fields and state transitions; record and parent belong to acting org; unknown fields are rejected.

specTasks.title: Correct coordination language/state
acceptanceCriteria: UI distinguishes suggestion/review/request/hold/confirmed; existing “auto-coordinate” action truthfully reports only records/tasks actually created.

specTasks.title: Add/verify org scope across logistics
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks, attachments, equipment, rentals, catering, maps, notes, collaborators, and child records pass direct-client multi-org tests.

specTasks.title: Define task taxonomy and authority
acceptanceCriteria: Domain/category values are non-overlapping; generic task versus structured entity responsibility is documented and enforced.

specTasks.title: Build canonical logistics command service
acceptanceCriteria: Per-action schemas, parent access, allowed transitions, idempotency, audit, and typed errors replace arbitrary record updates.

specTasks.title: Add tour-first scope/navigation
acceptanceCriteria: Logistics page supports organization → tour → stop/event/leg filters, preserves scope in URLs, and never defaults to a different org/tour silently.

specTasks.title: Create normalized route legs
acceptanceCriteria: Legs regenerate deterministically from stop ordering while preserving approved overrides/linked bookings; constraints prevent orphan legs.

specTasks.title: Implement provider abstraction
acceptanceCriteria: Distance/duration calculation supports one provider plus manual fallback; requests are cached, rate-limited, observable, and provider-neutral.

specTasks.title: Add time-zone and DST handling
acceptanceCriteria: Times store UTC plus location zone; UI shows local zones; DST transition tests and ambiguous/nonexistent local-time UX are complete.

specTasks.title: Add route constraint engine
acceptanceCriteria: Detect same-day overlaps, insufficient travel/buffer/rest, excessive drive, curfew conflict, border/ferry risk, missing location, and impossible arrival.

specTasks.title: Add driver/rest policy profiles
acceptanceCriteria: Organization selects policy template and may override with reason/capability; engine reports assumptions rather than presenting legal advice as certainty.

specTasks.title: Add travel/rest-day generation
acceptanceCriteria: User can insert suggested travel/rest days; adoption is explicit and creates versioned stops/legs.

specTasks.title: Build scenario workspace
acceptanceCriteria: Branch draft scenarios, compare distance/time/cost/risk/date conflicts, name/share internally, and adopt selected scenario with impact preview.

specTasks.title: Add route visualization
acceptanceCriteria: Map/timeline clearly distinguish confirmed, held, tentative, travel, and conflict states; accessible list provides equivalent information.

specTasks.title: Connect route legs to logistics
acceptanceCriteria: Each travel segment, vehicle movement, room night, equipment move, and passenger assignment references canonical stop/leg context.

specTasks.title: Connect party manifest to route legs
acceptanceCriteria: Matrix shows every active member versus every required leg/night and identifies not traveling, self-arranged, assigned, or missing.

specTasks.title: Build travel-segment commands
acceptanceCriteria: Create/request/hold/confirm/change/cancel/complete with validation, idempotency, confirmation evidence, and audit.

specTasks.title: Build passenger assignment workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Bulk assign by party group with preview; capacity, duplicate/overlap, accessibility, and missing-ticket conflicts are actionable.

specTasks.title: Build itinerary timeline
acceptanceCriteria: Per person/group/tour timeline merges route, transport, hotel, calls, and events in local time with gaps/overlaps and data freshness.

specTasks.title: Add change impact engine
acceptanceCriteria: Segment time/status changes identify affected passengers, connections, rooms, calls/shifts, equipment moves, costs, and publications before commit.

specTasks.title: Publish traveler-specific itinerary
acceptanceCriteria: Uses audience projection so each person receives their details and approved group context, with version/diff/acknowledgement and offline access.

specTasks.title: Create vehicle master and capacity
acceptanceCriteria: Owned/rented/vendor vehicles have seat/berth/cargo/accessibility/maintenance status; sensitive driver/document data is protected.

specTasks.title: Create vehicle movements
acceptanceCriteria: Movements align to route legs or local transfers; planned/actual time, pickup point, dispatcher/contact, passengers/cargo, status, and costs are complete.

specTasks.title: Add seat/berth assignment
acceptanceCriteria: Visual/list assignment respects capacity, restrictions, accessibility and overnight continuity; overbooking is blocked or explicitly overridden.

specTasks.title: Add driver assignment/rest checks
acceptanceCriteria: Driver qualifications, availability, planned hours/rest, handoffs, and acknowledgements are validated using configured policy.

specTasks.title: Add pickup/dropoff operations
acceptanceCriteria: Precise location/instructions, passenger check state, delay/exception, driver dispatch view, and offline contact fallback are provided.

specTasks.title: Track actual mileage/cost/issue
acceptanceCriteria: Fuel, toll, mileage, delay, damage/incident, and vendor issue feed finance/vendor performance and closeout.

specTasks.title: Build lodging block workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Request/hold/confirm/cancel/close with dates, room type counts, rates/tax, cutoff, attrition/terms, confirmation, owner, contract/cost links.

specTasks.title: Build nightly inventory matrix
acceptanceCriteria: Nights × room types show contracted, picked up, assigned, available, waitlisted, and variance; date/time-zone boundaries are correct.

specTasks.title: Build rooming-list assignment
acceptanceCriteria: Drag/list/bulk assignment supports roommate rules, single/crew preferences, accessibility, check-in/out differences, and explicit unresolved state.

specTasks.title: Add occupancy/capacity validation
acceptanceCriteria: Prevent impossible overlapping properties/rooms, excess guests, missing nights, late-arrival gaps, and unassigned active party members.

specTasks.title: Add confirmation/deadline workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Rooming cutoff, provider submission/version, confirmation numbers, changes after cutoff, acknowledgement, and escalation are tracked.

specTasks.title: Add payment/incidentals policy
acceptanceCriteria: Master/individual payment, deposit, tax, cancellation, incidentals responsibility, folio/receipt, and reconciliation fields feed finance.

specTasks.title: Publish lodging projections
acceptanceCriteria: Travelers receive only their property/room/check-in information and permitted roommate/contact detail; vendor receives authorized rooming list version.

specTasks.title: Upgrade task dependencies/checklists
acceptanceCriteria: Task supports blockers, dependencies, repeated checklist, source entity/version, completion validation, and explicit failed/unknown state.

specTasks.title: Build tour logistics board
acceptanceCriteria: Views by tour, stop, leg, department, owner, due, blocker, and domain; bulk changes preview eligibility and report partial failures.

specTasks.title: Create organization equipment catalog
acceptanceCriteria: Asset/type, serial/tag, ownership/vendor, dimensions/weight/value, current state, service due, and restricted financial fields are modeled.

specTasks.title: Build cases/kits and manifest versions
acceptanceCriteria: Managers compose department manifests, quantities, alternates, cases/contents, source, responsible role, and approval; published version is immutable.

specTasks.title: Connect equipment to route movements
acceptanceCriteria: Every required item/case has explicit location/movement/vehicle/owner state for relevant legs/stops; gaps and capacity issues are reported.

specTasks.title: Implement scan/custody workflow
acceptanceCriteria: QR/barcode/manual fallback records load, transfer, unload, check, condition, actor/device/time/location; offline queue is idempotent.

specTasks.title: Add load-in/load-out checklists
acceptanceCriteria: Templates derive from manifest and venue advance; exceptions require reason/photo/assignment and remain open through closeout.

specTasks.title: Add damage/loss/service workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Report, secure evidence, custody chain, severity, owner, vendor/insurance/finance link, resolution, replacement, and service history are complete.

specTasks.title: Normalize rental agreements
acceptanceCriteria: Vendor, items/quantity, dates/locations, terms/deposit, pickup/return, condition, contract/PO/invoice and status transitions are linked.

specTasks.title: Add rental conflict/return alerts
acceptanceCriteria: Detect date/quantity/source conflict, missing pickup/return owner, overdue return, damage, and cost variance with escalation.

specTasks.title: Normalize hospitality requirements
acceptanceCriteria: Approved rider/advance and party needs map to structured quantities/notes; source/version and local variance are visible.

specTasks.title: Build meal-service planner
acceptanceCriteria: Breakfast/lunch/dinner/snack/buyout/other includes window/location/provider/menu/headcount/cost/status/owner and event timeline conflicts.

specTasks.title: Generate privacy-safe headcounts
acceptanceCriteria: Headcount snapshot traces included groups and aggregates dietary/accessibility needs; identifiable exceptions require capability and purpose.

specTasks.title: Add menu/delivery approval
acceptanceCriteria: Provider proposal, internal approval/change, delivery acceptance, shortage/quality issue, and actual headcount/cost are tracked.

specTasks.title: Build hospitality delivery checklist
acceptanceCriteria: Rider items by room/location/window/quantity/provider are accepted with variance and linked to advance/site map/task.

specTasks.title: Publish crew/vendor views
acceptanceCriteria: Crew receives meal/service details; vendor receives only authorized quantities/windows/contacts/dietary aggregates and versioned changes.

specTasks.title: Create versioned organization templates
acceptanceCriteria: Template sections/fields, conditional requirements, default owners/due offsets, file types, validation, and version history are configurable without changing active advances.

specTasks.title: Build tour-wide advance matrix
acceptanceCriteria: Rows are stops and columns/filters are sections/status/owner/due date; bulk assign/remind/template actions preserve per-event differences.

specTasks.title: Add secure external request flow
acceptanceCriteria: Recipient receives expiring section-scoped link, verifies identity as configured, saves drafts, uploads safely, and cannot enumerate other events/sections.

specTasks.title: Add typed response and file validation
acceptanceCriteria: Values have units/time zones, contact structure, revision history, malware-scanned storage, file limits, and clear missing/invalid state.

specTasks.title: Add section ownership and approval
acceptanceCriteria: Owner, contributor, reviewer, due date, state, comments, change request, approval, and reopen reason are audited.

specTasks.title: Add reminder/escalation policy
acceptanceCriteria: Scheduled reminders are deduplicated, respect time zones/preferences, escalate overdue critical sections, and appear in delivery history.

specTasks.title: Add tour-standard variance detection
acceptanceCriteria: Compare local responses with rider/production standards, staffing, route, equipment, hospitality, curfew, and budget; assign exceptions for resolution.

specTasks.title: Freeze/export approved advance
acceptanceCriteria: Immutable version renders authorized web/PDF package and feeds run-of-show/day-sheet generation; later changes create a new version/diff.

specTasks.title: Create versioned run-of-show timeline
acceptanceCriteria: Items support local/UTC time, duration, dependency, location, owner/role, public/private notes, template source, and actual time.

specTasks.title: Add timeline validation
acceptanceCriteria: Detect overlap, dependency inversion, missing location/owner, travel/load timing conflict, curfew breach, and unstaffed critical item.

specTasks.title: Build day-sheet composer
acceptanceCriteria: Pulls canonical travel, lodging, calls/shifts, meals, advance, maps, contacts, weather placeholder/source, and emergency information with field-class policy.

specTasks.title: Publish recipient-specific day sheets
acceptanceCriteria: Uses publication service, version/diff/acknowledgement, and worker offline access; sensitive contacts/travel are audience-filtered.

specTasks.title: Add day-sheet correction workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Critical changes generate impact-based re-publication and acknowledgement; old version visibly superseded.

specTasks.title: Establish scoped realtime channel
acceptanceCriteria: Authorization is rechecked at subscribe and relevant permission changes; messages/events carry sequence and support reconnect/catch-up.

specTasks.title: Unify live tasks
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks link timeline/map/equipment/person/vendor, support priority/status/owner/due/blocked reason, and preserve audit without duplicating logistics categories.

specTasks.title: Implement incident workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Severity, privacy, reporter, participants, response owner, escalation, resolution, follow-up, files, and restricted audit are complete; emergency copy is reviewed.

specTasks.title: Harden check-in
acceptanceCriteria: Eligibility derives from credential/assignment; duplicate/offline/manual/denied/revoked cases are handled; operator/device and reason are audited.

specTasks.title: Capture planned versus actual
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized operators mark actual start/end/delay and reason; downstream timeline/notifications update without mutating the published planned version.

specTasks.title: Create event closeout
acceptanceCriteria: Checklist covers incidents, lost/damaged equipment, staff exceptions, attendance, vendor issues, actual timings, documents, and handoff to finance/settlement.

specTasks.title: Add provider adapter boundary
acceptanceCriteria: Imported booking updates are verified/idempotent, preserve provider event, map to canonical state, and route unmatched records for review.

specTasks.title: Add document storage
acceptanceCriteria: Tickets, vouchers, confirmations, manifests, and hotel lists use malware-scanned org-scoped storage with audience-aware access and retention.

specTasks.title: Add route metrics and alerting
acceptanceCriteria: Track calculation errors, provider latency/cost, override rate, unresolved conflicts, stale legs, and last successful recompute.

specTasks.title: Add operational observability
acceptanceCriteria: Alert on realtime failures, stale clients, notification backlog, overdue critical tasks, missing acknowledgements, check-in anomalies, and unresolved high-severity incidents.

specTasks.title: Add logistics SLO/alerts
acceptanceCriteria: Missing next-72-hour segments/rooms, capacity conflicts, stale confirmations, delay impacts, import failures, and notification failure are monitored.

specTasks.title: Complete migration/reconciliation
acceptanceCriteria: Legacy groups/flights/lodging records reconcile to canonical parent/child counts; unscoped data is resolved; old writes/policies are retired.

specTasks.title: Replace weak logistics metrics
acceptanceCriteria: Metrics have definitions and show unresolved critical tasks, late/blocked work, manifest completeness, scan exceptions, meal/room/equipment capacity, and freshness.

specTasks.title: Add operational alerts
acceptanceCriteria: Upcoming missing/late equipment, unreturned rentals, meal headcount deadline, unresolved map approval, and failed publication notify responsible owner.

specTasks.title: Complete migration/retirement
acceptanceCriteria: Generic task records that represented domain facts are linked/migrated without history loss; duplicate categories and old writes are retired.

workflows.title: Logistics, Travel, Lodging, Catering, and Site Maps

recipients.outcome: Receives only assigned operational details and acknowledgement requests.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Every parent and child row carries validated organization ownership and direct child-ID operations recheck the parent chain.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: Recipients see current scoped logistics without cross-organization or protected-data leakage.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

references.canonicalSource: Authenticated acting-context and capability command wrappers
invariants: Organization and actor context come from trusted server state.
Every mutation declares capability, target, validation, idempotency, audit, and stable errors.

references.canonicalSource: events_v2, canonical tour access, and persisted plan/publication services
invariants: Legacy event identifiers are exposed only through the governed migration mapping.

references.canonicalSource: Shared Admin page header and explicit loading, empty, error, and permission states
invariants: Live Admin UI contains no mock or synthetic operational data.
Every surface provides accessible loading, empty, error, denied, success, and recovery behavior as applicable.

launchGates.title: Admin automated tests pass
launchGates.acceptance: All Admin suites pass with no unexplained skips.

launchGates.title: Two-organization RLS matrix passes
launchGates.acceptance: Positive and cross-organization negative cases pass for every exposed domain.

launchGates.title: Performance and reliability acceptance
launchGates.acceptance: Query budgets, retries, idempotency, observability, and failure recovery meet approved thresholds.
